newsitem.title: GERMANY: Frankfurt express/mail conference draws 300 delegates.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurt express/mail conference draws 300 delegates.

text.p: Some 300 delegates are expected at the eighth World Express and Mail Conference and Exhibition in Frankfurt on May 14-15, organiser Triangle Management Services said.
Triangle spokesman Chris Pocock said the event's "Express for All" slogan aimed to show express freight was now entering the heavy freight market and was a subject for all cargo operators.
A top speaker is Jean-Francois Pons, deputy director general of the European Commission's competition department, DG IV.
Other speakers include Schenker International airfreight director Klaus Geissler and representatives of DHL Worldwide Express, UPS and TNT Express Worldwide.

Sessions will include integrated freight/post partnerships, parcels and mail handling, the German express market and electronic data interchange (EDI). -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706; Fax: 5017
